# dash0_aws_log_group_policy (Resource)

Manages the log-group instrumentation policy of a Dash0 AWS integration: which CloudWatch log groups Dash0 forwards, selected by the log groups' own tags.

Each AWS integration has at most one policy. Declare at most one `dash0_aws_log_group_policy` per integration. The policy belongs to the integration's dataset, so the resource has no `dataset` attribute.

A log group is forwarded when its tags match any of `spec.rules`; all conditions of a rule must hold. Log groups selected by hand in Dash0 keep forwarding regardless of the policy.

Terraform writes the whole policy on every apply, without a revision check, so changes made in the Dash0 UI are overwritten. Dash0 records the writer of a policy as its owner (the `origin`). If another client already owns an active policy for the integration, the first apply fails with a conflict: import the policy, or delete it in Dash0, first.

Destroying the resource deletes the policy. `deletion_disposition` decides what happens to the log groups it forwards: `keep` (the default) keeps them forwarding, `remove` removes their subscription filters. The AWS integration itself is kept.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Forward the CloudWatch log groups of an AWS integration that carry matching tags.
# Each integration has at most one policy, so declare at most one
# dash0_aws_log_group_policy per integration_id.
#
# A log group is forwarded when its own tags match any rule; every condition of
# a rule must hold. Tag keys are written as dash0.cloud.tags.<tag name>.
resource "dash0_aws_log_group_policy" "prod" {
  integration_id = "27755ed0-0009-422d-8c11-19c6dd72df98"

  # What destroying this resource does to the log groups it forwards:
  # "keep" (the default) keeps them forwarding, "remove" removes their
  # subscription filters. Apply the change before you destroy.
  deletion_disposition = "keep"

  aws_log_group_policy_yaml = <<-YAML
apiVersion: dash0.com/v1alpha1
kind: Dash0AwsLogGroupInstrumentationPolicy
spec:
  onNoLongerMatching: keep
  rules:
    - conditions:
        - key: dash0.cloud.tags.team
          operator: is_one_of
          values: [checkout, payments]
        - key: dash0.cloud.tags.env
          operator: is
          value: production
    - conditions:
        - key: dash0.cloud.tags.dash0-forward
          operator: is_set
YAML
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `aws_log_group_policy_yaml` (String) The policy in YAML format, with `apiVersion: dash0.com/v1alpha1`, `kind: Dash0AwsLogGroupInstrumentationPolicy` and a `spec.rules` list. Each rule has a `conditions` list; a condition has a `key` (a log-group tag written as `dash0.cloud.tags.<tag name>`), an `operator` (`is`, `is_one_of`, `is_set`, `starts_with`, `ends_with` or `contains`), and a `value` or, for `is_one_of`, `values`. `spec.onNoLongerMatching` (`keep` or `remove`, default `keep`) decides what happens to a log group that stops matching. `metadata` is managed by Dash0 and ignored.
- `integration_id` (String) The id (UUID) of the Dash0 AWS integration whose log-group policy this resource manages. Changing this value forces the resource to be recreated.

### Optional

- `deletion_disposition` (String) What happens to the log groups the policy forwards when the resource is destroyed or replaced: `keep` keeps them forwarding, `remove` removes their subscription filters. Defaults to `keep`. Set it to `remove` and apply before destroying to stop forwarding.

### Read-Only

- `origin` (String) The `dash0.com/origin` label of the policy, which records who manages it. Generated on creation as `tf_<uuid>` and refreshed from Dash0 on read. Null for a policy imported without an origin.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
#!/bin/bash
# The import ID is the id (UUID) of the AWS integration: there is at most one
# log-group policy per integration, and no dataset prefix.
terraform import dash0_aws_log_group_policy.prod 27755ed0-0009-422d-8c11-19c6dd72df98
```
